clue.text: Minor league championship in which one takes the lead

indicators.text: in which one takes the lead

explanation.surface: A minor-league sports championship in which one team moves into first place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Minor league' reads as one phrase, but Minor is the definition and league is just L. The I in TITLE moves from second place to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Little and minor are synonyms for small or of slight importance, as in a minor or little problem.
